title.rendered: How Much Does It Cost to Hire JavaScript Developers in Ukraine?

content.rendered:
JavaScript is, at the moment, the dominating language for web development. According to this year’s Stack Overflow developer survey, over 69% of respondents use JavaScript for development projects – last year, the percentage of JS users was 62%. You may check JavaScript frameworks comparison to see who among JS developers earn the most.

The growth of the popularity of JavaScript is impossible to question or put in doubt. The reason for the language’s domination has been explicitly described:

Any application that can be written in JavaScript will eventually be written in JavaScript
Jeff Atwood
Stack Overflow’s founder

No doubt, there is no shortage for job possibilities a JavaScript developer is open to. In fact, JS is the most-searched-for programming language in job listings. The dominance of the language, at no doubt, has influenced the salaries. According to Stack Overflow, the average salary for JavaScript developers is over $50 000.

JavaScript Developer Salary Trends: 2022

With newcomers constantly breaking into the industry, a JS developer might be wondering what the future holds for the industry. Some might wonder if the supply doesn’t surpass the demand by 2020 or if the JS developer salaries don’t take the fall due to the development of CMS engines.

Research assures software engineers that there isn’t a reason to worry. According to Robert Half and other estimations, the demand for front-end development will grow by as much as 27%.

As to the salaries, the overall state of web development cost estimation will be as favorable as it gets. According to the International Labor Organization survey, the salary of JavaScript developer is growing at a rate of approximately 5% by 2020.

While exploring the costs associated with hiring JavaScript developers in Ukraine, it’s also worth considering Scala developers for hire, as their expertise in handling complex server-side applications can complement JavaScript’s front-end capabilities.

JavaScript Web Developer Salary Canada, US, Europe

JavaScript developers are in demand everywhere in the world, as of now. It’s safe to say a developer won’t be out of a job regardless of the country he lives in. However, someplace the competition is higher than elsewhere – take main tech hubs (the US, the UK, Germany, France, and Switzerland) as an example.

Here’s the result of the analysis of JS developer salaries in the main tech hubs of the world. JavaScript programming salary analysis for most popular outsourcing destinations has been included to the list as well.

United States Javascript Developers Market Overview

The United States is a leader when it comes to all things digital – web development included. Here are some numbers that will give a better idea of the American JavaScript market (according to GooRoo):

  • Average salary JavaScript developer – $104,000 per year;
  • The number of monthly job offers posted – 15,357;
  • Top states by JS developer salaries – Connecticut, Massachusetts. The third highest is the NYC.

Here’s how salaries in the US are distributed by the level of experience (according to Indeed.com):

  • Up to 1 year – $60,000 per year;
  • 2-4 years – $66,000 per year;
  • 5-9 years – $84,000 per year;
  • 10-19 years – $99,000 per year;
  • Over 20 years – $110,000 per year.

JavaScript engineer salary according to company size (data provided by PayScale):

  • Up to 10 people – $72,300 per year;
  • 10-50 people – $70,200 per year;
  • 51-200 people – $76,150 per year;
  • 201-600 people – $78,700 per year;
  • 601-2,000 people – $83,400 per year;
  • 2,001-5,000 people – $81,200 per year;
  • 5,001-20,000 people – $87,500 per year;
  • Over 50,000 people – $87,400 per year.

United Kingdom Javascript Developers Market Overview

While Brexit might have affected the British economy at some levels, when it comes to software development, the UK is going strong and leads the way in Europe. The flourishing of JS development has reflected positively on the salaries making British JS developers the leaders by wages.

The JavaScript developer salary in the UK  is $81,267 per year. That’s almost 60% higher than the average salary in the job market of the country. Unlike many other industries that develop with a negative rate (the annual job market change average in the UK is 0.6%), JS developer salary has grown by 6%.

France Javascript Developers Market Overview

Speaking of European main tech hubs, it would be wrong to leave France aside. The country has a strong growing demand for tech professionals as well as the bunch of skilled coders graduating French polytechnical schools every year.

By salaries, France is among the European leaders. This stands true for software development as well.

The average JavaScript developer salary in France: $51,770 per year.

Poland Javascript Developers Market Overview

Being one of the cheapest countries for living in the European Union, Poland is among the top web development outsourcing destination for JS development outsourcing. The reason for the country being on the top of offshore development is a relatively low web developer salary rates.

The average developer salary in Poland (according to PayScale): $36,161 per year. Hiring an entry developer, you can settle for  $25,761 per year. However, if you’re looking for the country’s best professionals, get ready to pay as much as $44,752+ per year.

Ukraine Javascript Developers Market Overview

If you’re looking for an outsourcing destination for JS development, Ukraine is among the top picks. By the quality of development, it doesn’t give way to any other European country. However, due to a crisis in the job market, the salaries of Ukrainian JS developer are quite low.

To give you a better idea about the state of JS developer salaries in Ukraine, here are some numbers (backed up by the data provided by DOU – the biggest developers community in Ukraine).

  • Entry level – $12,000* per year;
  • Middle level – $24,000* per year;
  • Senior level – $48,000* per year.

*Ukrainian salaries are provided based on Mobilunity’s Recruitment Team research on the local job markets. All salaries are net and do not include the service fee (in case of hiring on a dedicated team model). The salaries are provided for comparison purposes and could be not entirely accurate. Contact us to know the exact cost of hiring a developer corresponding to the required parameters.

JavaScript Salary Comparison in Different Сities

In order to provide business owners and developers with a better overview on JS developer salary in the top tech hubs, we created a comparative salary table that you can see below:

JS Developer Salary in Different Cities of Ukraine

According to the survey provided by DOU – the online community of Ukrainian developers, the top Ukrainian software development hubs are Kiev, Kharkiv, Lviv, Dnipro, and Odessa.

Let’s take a look at the average JS developer salary for each of the cities:

Kyiv Javascript Developer Salaries

  • Junior JavaScript developer salary – $700 per month;
  • Middle level – $1,850 per month;
  • Senior level – $3,600 per month.

Lviv Javascript Developer Salaries

  • Junior level- $590 per month;
  • Middle level – $2,000 per month;
  • Senior JavaScript developer salary – $3,500 per month.

Kharkiv Javascript Developer Salaries

  • Jr JavaScript developer salary – $600 per month;
  • Middle level – $1,600 per month;
  • Senior level – $3,250 per month.

Dnipro Javascript Developer Salaries

  • Junior level – $600 per month;
  • Middle level – $1,825 per month;
  • Senior level – $3,000 per month.

Odessa Javascript Developer Salaries

  • Junior level – $600 per month;
  • Middle level – $1,950 per month;
  • Senior level – $3,700 per month.

How Much Would You Save Hiring a Team of Ukrainian Developers?

While Ukraine is one of the cheapest countries to hire javascript programmer, looking at the numbers for other outsourcing locations – Philippines, India – it’s clear there are even cheaper destinations.

Regardless, Ukrainian IT market is very well thought of when it comes to big European and American companies and provides a very high-quality labor force. Let’s take a look at the numbers to prove the point:

  • Ukraine is a top development outsourcer to Great Britain.
  • According to Global Outsourcing List, out of the top 100 outsourcing companies, 13 are Ukrainian.
  • Ukraine is geographically convenient. Being located in the very heart of Europe, Ukraine is not difficult to reach for a face-to-face meeting unlike Asia or Latin America.
  • Price aligns well with the quality. The cost of development is relatively low but the quality of development is not worth than that of Polish, German, French, British, or American developers.
  • Favorable taxation. Tax policy in Ukraine presents no challenges for foreign businesses. If your company is located in the EU and you’re a taxpayer, there is no need to pay additional taxes in Ukraine.
